_comment: Games whose romset cannot run under any installed core, and which are not
worth reporting as gaps because nothing here can fix them: the zip holds a
different regional revision than the driver of that name expects, so the
fix is a different dump, not a scrape or a setting.
Verified by launching each headless against fbneo, mame2003_plus and mame.
See docs/arcade-missing-roms.md for the file and CRC each one wants.
